description_en: Queries the list of resources with the most risks
description_zh: 查询风险最多的资源列表
name: DescribeTopRiskyResources

parameters.help_en: The resource category ID. Filters the computation results by the specified resource category. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied. You can specify multiple resource category IDs separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源分类 ID。过滤指定资源分类的资源计算结果，不填则不过滤。支持使用英文逗号（,）分隔传入多个资源分类 ID
parameters.name: resource_category_id

parameters.help_en: The list of resource owner IDs, used in cross-account unified management. Filters the computation results by the specified accounts. If this parameter is not specified, data of the current logon account is returned
parameters.help_zh: 资源所有者 ID 列表，在跨账号统一管理中使用。过滤指定账号的资源计算结果，不填则获取当前登录账号的数据
parameters.name: resource_owner_ids
